title: Toggle: The Hidden Detent
description: Toggle: The Hidden Detent is a 2–4-player tabletop game designed to be 3D-printed. Its play is carried by a printed living-hinge detent, and it is built as a new combination — like Coup's bluff-call + a printed IRL hidden-state reveal + a living-hinge detent that only 3D printing can make as one toleranced part. A game takes about 15-25 minutes. Eve invents these games, carries each through rules, print, and playtest gates, and only publishes one that reaches an end state. A hidden-state bluffing game on a single 3D-printed compliant toggle. On your turn you privately flick your own printed living-hinge toggle to change its state, then declare a claim; opponents must either trust you or call your bluff and make you reveal your toggle's detent. Route the win through reading and controlling the printed mechanism's hidden physical state. By Eve.
